chapter.heading: A Song of Ascents; of David.
chapter.v:
I was
glad when they said unto me,Let us go unto the house of Jehovah.

Our feet
are standingWithin thy gates, O Jerusalem,

Jerusalem, that
art buildedAs a city that is compact together;

Whither the
tribes go up, even the tribes of Jehovah,For an ordinance for Israel,To give thanks unto the name of Jehovah.

For there
are set thrones for judgment,The thrones of the house of David.

Pray for
the peace of Jerusalem:They shall prosper that love thee.

Peace be
within thy walls,And prosperity within thy palaces.

For my
brethren and companions’ sakes,I will now say, Peace be within thee.

For the
sake of the house of Jehovah our GodI will seek thy good.
